== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-magneticsuctiontube-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Magnetic Suction Tube (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 25 January 2018): Same game text. The game text is set again; the bronze disc is gone and a white italic “E” is in the black lower border.

The whole earlier image and the whole new image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
